text:
ITEM 1 | Dark green leafy greens (spinach-like leaves with some red-purple stems and veins), wilted and glossy with a light oily or dressed sheen, piled in a loose mound about 12 cm across covering roughly one third of the plate on the right side; leaves are soft, flat, and slightly layered, with a few torn edges | 75
ITEM 2 | Thin julienne shreds of bright orange carrot, roughly 3-5 cm long and 2-3 mm thick, scattered over and among the greens, with a few shreds loose on the plate; crisp-looking, matte, no cooking marks | 12
ITEM 3 | Whole blueberries, dark blue-black with a slight bloom, about 1.5 cm in diameter, five to six visible, sitting on and beside the greens and two resting on the bare plate near the bottom center; firm, round, not juicy-looking | 8
ITEM 4 | Small pale green seeds (pumpkin-seed-like), flat and oval about 1 cm long, scattered in a few spots on and beside the greens; dry, matte, no sheen | 1
ITEM 5 | Light oily dressing or vinaigrette, visible as a slight glossy sheen on the leaves and a faint film around the greens on the plate; no pooled liquid | 4
